notes.title: ⚔️ Patch V1.3.5 – Dungeon Expansion, Elite Monsters & More!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Dungeon Expansion, Elite Monsters & More![/b][/h2][p]Hi Hunters![/p][p]I'm back with some exciting news! After yesterday’s release of the new event mini-dungeon, I went straight back to work fixing a few bugs. But while doing that, I figured... why stop there? So, I’ve added [b]even more content[/b] for you to enjoy right now. Let’s dive into the details:[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]🕳️ Event Mini-Dungeon Expansion[/b][/h3][p]The event dungeon just got a makeover! It’s now [b]bigger[/b], with [b]more resource nodes[/b] to farm. This improvement should make your gathering and crafting journey a lot more rewarding![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141283/4f0840f3f30905803e7578c3616937d7c0f209a5.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]👑 New Elite Monster: Goblin King - Elite Variant[/b][/h3][p]Introducing a more dangerous version of the Goblin King!
This elite foe is [b]stronger[/b] and comes with [b]enhanced loot drops[/b]. If you think you're ready for a challenge, this is your opportunity to earn valuable rewards – just be careful, it won’t go down easy![/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]🛡️ New Craftable Shield (Rare)[/b][/h3][p]A powerful [b]rare shield[/b] has been added to the game!
You can now [b]unlock its blueprint[/b] through the [b]Base Master[/b]. Once you’ve learned the blueprint, head to the blacksmith to start crafting your new defense gear and shield yourself from incoming threats.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141283/21632b26d13ea62bfb4399d570cde1863023dff7.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]🔧 Base Master Updates[/b][/h3][p]Big improvements here!
The [b]Base Master[/b] now gives you [b]access to all currently available blueprints[/b], plus [b]construction jobs[/b] needed to unlock more weapons and crafting NPCs. No more searching around — everything you need starts at the Base Master![/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]🍷 New Event Potion Item[/b][/h3][p]A brand new [b]event potion[/b] has been added to the [b]Shop[/b] and is also available through the [b]Alchemist NPC[/b]. Grab these while you can! They could give you that edge you need on harder challenges.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]🌍 Prepare for the Outlands[/b][/h3][p]With these changes, you’ll start getting a taste of the [b]true power levels[/b] you’ll face in the [b]Outlands[/b] — coming very soon!
Now is the perfect time to [b]level up, fine-tune your build, and stockpile resources[/b]. Once the Outlands drop... you'll want to be ready, or you may face a world that destroys the unprepared![/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you all for continuing to explore, support, and enjoy [i]Dungeon Reborn[/i]!
And as always — don’t forget to [url="https://discord.gg/Ya9KwQmy34" style="button"]join us on Discord![/url] I’m active daily for bug reports, feedback, or just to chat with the community. Let's continue building this adventure together.[/p][p]Stay strong,
[b]– PixelPulse Studio[/b][/p]

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE: V1.2.0

notes.title: New Update, New Price, and What’s Next for the Game
notes.notes: [p][b]Hello Hunters,[/b][/p][p]I’ve been hard at work finishing up the last bug fixes and polishing the dungeon loop, and we're almost there! I'm excited to announce that the new update will officially launch **tomorrow afternoon (CEST time)**.[/p][p]Even more exciting news: thanks to additional funding, I now have more time and resources to further improve the game. This means I’ll be able to add even more awesome mechanics and features to deliver the truly grindy, fun dungeon-crawling experience you've come to expect — and this update is just the beginning. More content is already planned for the future![/p][p]To make the game accessible to more players, starting today, the price will be reduced from **$3.99 to $1.99**. My goal has always been to create a game that's enjoyable and easy for everyone to jump into, and I believe this move will help bring more hunters into the fold.[/p][p]Also, keep an eye out for our brand-new **gameplay trailer**, which is currently uploading and will be available soon on the main Steam page.[/p][p]Thank you all for your continued support — it means the world. I can’t wait for you to dive into this new update. Until then…[/p][p]Happy hunting![/p][p][b]— PixelPulse Studio[/b][/p]

I'm happy to report that all known issues have been resolved, but please don't hesitate to reach out if you encounter anything else – I'm committed to keeping your experience smooth and enjoyable.[/p][p][b]This Week's Update Preview[/b][/p][p]Now, let's dive into what's coming in this week's exciting update! notes.title: Major Update Patch V1.0.0
notes.notes: [p][b]Hello Heroes![/b][/p][p]It's been quite a while since our last update, and we've had some significant changes behind the scenes. Unfortunately, our former development team was disbanded, which required me to take time to reinvest and rebuild as an independent developer.[/p][p]After careful consideration, I've made the exciting decision to transition from our previous 3D format to a polished 2D RPG experience. This shift better aligns with my strengths as a developer and allows me to utilize specialized software that will streamline the development process going forward.[/p][p][b]A Heartfelt Apology[/b][/p][p]I want to sincerely apologize to all our amazing supporters who have patiently waited for updates. Your dedication means everything, and I'm thrilled to finally bring you the full access release you've been waiting for![/p][p][b]Looking Ahead[/b][/p][p]This release marks a new beginning, not an end. I'm committed to continuously updating and expanding the game for years to come, evolving it into the ultimate cozy, grindy RPG dungeon crawler experience. Expect regular updates, new content, and exciting expansions in the future.[/p][p][b]What's New[/b][/p][p]Now, let's dive into the exciting changes you'll discover when you start playing![/p][p][/p][h1]New Game Experience[/h1][p][/p][p][b]Epic Adventure Awaits[/b][/p][p]Begin your journey as a hero mysteriously transported to an unknown realm. A mystical spirit will guide you through the fundamentals of this dangerous world, teaching you essential survival skills before releasing you into full sandbox mode. From there, the pace is entirely yours—but remember, this is still a dungeon crawler at heart, and monsters lurk around every corner, ready to strike![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Core Mechanics:[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]🔨 Crafting System[/b][/p][p]Venture into the Tower to gather valuable resources, then return to your headquarters to craft essential upgrades for both yourself and your base. Every expedition brings new materials and possibilities for advancement.[/p][p][b]👥 Party System[/b]  [/p][p]Solo adventures have their limits! Recruit skilled mercenaries and various hero classes to join your expeditions. The Tower's deepest levels are impossible to conquer alone—teamwork is essential for survival and success.[/p][p][b]🏗️ Building Mode[/b][/p][p]Design and construct your perfect base using our blueprint system. As you progress and upgrade, new construction options and features will unlock, giving you even more ways to customize your headquarters. [i](More building content coming soon!)[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]What's Next?[/b][/p][p]These features are just the beginning! I'm committed to releasing substantial updates throughout this week and next, so stay tuned for exciting new content.[/p][p][/p][h1]Join Our Community  [/h1][p][/p][p][b]Don't forget to join our Discord server![/b] I'm actively [b]engaged there as the developer, ready to:[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Chat with players directly[/p][/*][*][p]Receive bug reports and feedback[/p][/*][*][p]Share immediate patch notes and updates[/p][/*][*][p]Host community discussions[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I'm also planning to introduce a community idea hub where [b]you[/b] can influence the world's economy—this will become increasingly important as we develop the Grand Bazaar feature![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/Ya9KwQmy34"]https://discord.gg/Ya9KwQmy34[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for your incredible support and patience. Enjoy the adventure![/p][p][/p][p][b]Happy Gaming![/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]Greetings,[/i][/p][p][b]PixelPulse Studio[/b][/p]

notes.title: Major Update Part 1
notes.notes:
Hunters, rejoice!

The long-awaited game update is finally here! This massive overhaul rebuilds the game from the ground up, creating a richer experience with enhanced storytelling, gameplay, and world-building. Unfortunately, this means your old saves won't be compatible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141283/48a870ff1b2278cfc5547dfb687c967092deca96.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141283/e90ff83fe636e52e88dc8ddd471ab55b70af09b9.png[/img]

Due to the size of this update, it will be released in two parts. Part 1, available today, introduces the initial tutorial story, featuring early main characters and your first taste of battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141283/06458d25f9a146a177cb492c86b793e5a6e2c421.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141283/07dc6f89b40990434ce0c81ff18c089e978d4626.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141283/b41eb2cd935ff83b4a0bbc538f39a26f8b2e678c.png[/img]

Part 2, arriving between tomorrow and Thursday, will unlock a larger map for exploration and hunting, along with the continuation of the story.

Thank you for your patience and support. While I couldn't deliver the complete package as initially planned, I'm committed to releasing Part 2 as soon as possible.

Stay updated and join the community on Discord!

Happy Hunting!

CH-Gaming Studio

notes.title: Exciting News & Big Changes Coming to Dungeon Reborn!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hunters,[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141283/f462fc3e3dea5c2d3e2845a0e325416cee77bf03.png[/img]

It's been a while since my last update, and unfortunately, I wasn't able to release the new version this week as planned. I've hit a few snags, but don't worry, there's good news on the horizon!

I'm taking the game in a new and much bigger direction! Get ready for a truly immersive world with expanded maps, a deeper story, and more interactive gameplay.

Here's what you can expect:

[b]Revamped Maps:[/b] Explore larger, more detailed environments with more to discover.
[b]Story-Driven Gameplay:[/b] Uncover a richer narrative as you progress.
[b]Expanded Activities:[/b] Embark on quests, craft items, trade with merchants, and much more!
This new approach gives me the freedom to be more creative and deliver an even better gaming experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141283/f462fc3e3dea5c2d3e2845a0e325416cee77bf03.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141283/dbc61f7872fcb003e754f82c1fb800493ec0d27f.png[/img]

[b]Release Date:[/b] The updated game, including the new dungeon map and level cap increase from the roadmap, will launch on Tuesday afternoon GMT.

Best of all, the price will remain at $3.99! I believe everyone should have a chance to enjoy this adventure.

I'm incredibly excited about this new chapter and can't wait for you to experience it.

Happy Hunting!

Best Regards,
CH-Gaming Studio

notes.title: Major Update V0.6.0
notes.notes:
Shadows of the Void is HERE! 🌑⚔️ + New Challenge Awaits!

Hey Hunter,

Guess who's back with awesome news?! Shadow of the Void is officially released! 🎉

But that's not all...  😈  Get ready to face the Nightmare Void, a powerful Skeleton Knight who controls his own space within the game. He's looking for worthy challengers, and that means YOU!

Take on his challenge and earn sweet rewards to prepare for the upcoming crafting system.  The blacksmith will be setting up shop soon, so make sure you're stocked up on resources by farming the Nightmare Void while you can!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141283/254559a2b9de7dabfb68c0587a19688e9028124c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141283/5398e2f738490bfcce4209970db5e20e7d5f2a6f.png[/img]

A New Look for the Hub! ✨

The hub has gotten a makeover!  I've redesigned all the NPCs, and the shop owner is finally open for business!  Stop by to stock up on potions and a stylish new armor piece.

This is just the beginning of many exciting improvements to the hub, so stay tuned for more updates in the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141283/fd76fe242075c84df7af45c3ebb779b99c131480.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141283/a94d903dac56415c2708b4a7d767fe3fda0040d9.png[/img]

Level Up! 💪

Prepare for even greater challenges, Hunter! The level cap has been raised to 15.  Start grinding now and boost those stats – you'll need every advantage to face the fearsome new monsters coming soon!

Bug Fixes: 🐞

We've been hard at work squashing those pesky bugs!  You should notice a smoother experience in the first map and tutorial.

Join the Community!

Don't forget to join our Discord server for the latest news, strategies, and to connect with other players! 

Have a great evening, and happy hunting!

Kind Regards,

CH-Gaming Studio

notes.title: Major update V0.5.0

I'm excited to announce that Dungeon Reborn is finally launching in Early Access! It's been a while since my last update, but I've been hard at work making the game even better.

One major change is that I've switched to a more powerful game engine. This has allowed me to upgrade the visuals from simple sprites to a more impressive 2D/3D style.  Check out the difference!

Old Version:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141283/6ca13c08d506495dbd861fe0e742a41e8b9c4510.png[/img]

With these new visuals, Dungeon Reborn is ready for a bright future! Here's what you can expect in the Early Access version (V0.5.0):

[list]
[*]First Hub Map & Dungeon: Explore the first hub area and complete a dungeon to get a feel for the gameplay. You'll be able to reach level 10, and even activate your first Guardian! 

[*]Roadmap: I'll be releasing a roadmap tomorrow outlining future updates and features planned for the game.

[*]Pricing: Dungeon Reborn is priced at just $3.99. I believe everyone should have the chance to enjoy a great dungeon crawling experience, and I want to keep the game accessible.  Rest assured, this doesn't mean the game will be short! I'm committed to adding tons of content and planning to supporting the game through the end of next year and beyond.
[/list]

I'm thrilled to finally share Dungeon Reborn with you all.  Have fun diving into the dungeons!

notes.title: Upcoming Early Access Release!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Hunters,

In just two weeks, the game will be available in early access. I am working tirelessly to implement new features and improve gameplay for the upcoming release.

Here are some details on what I am currently working on:

1. A new Medal system: This feature allows players to complete challenges within dungeons to earn medals that provide significant stat boosts and other benefits. These medals can be a game changer in certain situations.

2. Gathering and Building: I am currently developing two different setups for players to build their main base, where they will spend most of their time before heading out on hunts in the Dungeons. I am continuously exploring ways to add new and exciting elements while maintaining balance.

3. Leveling and Skill Leveling: The maximum level cap for the game will be 99 for now (subject to change in future updates), but that's not all - your skills also have their own levels that increase as you use them, up to level 99. This may also be expanded upon in future updates, with each level providing a boost to your skill powers.

And there's much more to come! For now, I wish you all a fantastic day. Don't forget to Wishlist the game if you're interested, and feel free to join our Discord server to stay updated on development and chat with me, the developer, for more information about the upcoming game.
